LESSON: HADITH ON FITNESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Etiquette of Eating (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-stran
Topic 2.4: Hadith on Fitness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hadith on Fitness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should one be physically fit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
2. value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living

Teach
• Today’s focus: read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living” using a school example.
• Model B for “read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

Teach
• Today’s focus: value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T).
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)” using a school example.
• Model B for “value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
• Model 2: value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
2. Practise: value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Fitness.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one be physically fit?
2. What Islamic rules should a Muslim observe while participating in games and sports activities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
• value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
